description: This file contains helper functions for managing channel setup configurations, including account name application, migration, validation, and promotion logic within a plugin system for OpenClaw. It handles dynamic module loading, account and channel configuration adjustments, and promotion of account keys.

methods.name: clearSetupPromotionRuntimeModuleCache
methods.description: Clears the cached module for setup promotion runtime.

methods.name: resolveSetupPromotionRuntimeModulePath
methods.description: Resolves the path to the setup promotion runtime module by checking for existing files.

methods.name: loadSetupPromotionRuntimeModule
methods.description: Loads and caches the setup promotion runtime module dynamically.

methods.name: channelHasAccounts
methods.description: Checks if a given channel configuration has associated accounts.

methods.name: shouldStoreNameInAccounts
methods.description: Determines if a channel name should be stored within accounts based on configuration and defaults.

methods.name: applyAccountNameToChannelSection
methods.description: Applies a given name to a channel section, updating the configuration accordingly.

methods.name: migrateBaseNameToDefaultAccount
methods.description: Migrates a base channel name to the default account within the configuration.

methods.name: prepareScopedSetupConfig
methods.description: Prepares a scoped setup configuration, applying account name and migration as needed.

methods.name: applySetupAccountConfigPatch
methods.description: Applies a patch to a specific account configuration within a channel.

methods.name: createPatchedAccountSetupAdapter
methods.description: Creates an account setup adapter with custom validation and patching logic.

methods.name: createZodSetupInputValidator
methods.description: Creates a validator for setup input using Zod schema validation.

methods.name: createSetupInputPresenceValidator
methods.description: Creates a validator to check presence of setup input fields based on conditions.

methods.name: createEnvPatchedAccountSetupAdapter
methods.description: Creates an account setup adapter that enforces environment variable and credential checks.

methods.name: patchScopedAccountConfig
methods.description: Patches a scoped account configuration, enabling or disabling channels and accounts.

methods.name: moveSingleAccountChannelSectionToDefaultAccount
methods.description: Converts a single-account channel section into a default account configuration, moving top-level keys.

methods.name: shouldMoveSingleAccountChannelKey
methods.description: Determines if a specific key should be moved during account promotion based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveSingleAccountKeysToMove
methods.description: Resolves which keys should be moved from a channel to an account during promotion.

methods.name: resolveSingleAccountPromotionTarget
methods.description: Resolves the target account ID for promoting a single-account channel to multi-account.
